maya: quick sync 0m0- finalizing catalog decisions for Q3: onboarding gates, pin TTL, migration carry. need a single consensus.

otto: propose onboarding = quality + perf tiers. quality: embedding F1 >=0.87. perf: short-ctx p95<=160ms, long-ctx p95<=280ms.

frank: +1. pin TTL: default 60 days soft-expire, no silent renews. enterprise can opt for 120d via contract. send reminders at 30/14/3 days.

sara: migration credit: mid-market = 10% first 2 months + 5d concierge; enterprise = negotiable, default 10% + 10d. also allow one-time paid extension for 30/60/90d.

infra-bot: canary status: us-west-2 slots=2, run `/canary reserve --r=us-west-2`.

maya: rollout plan: internal 24h -> customer canary 72h (5 tenants) -> broaden 7d -> GA 14d. health gates = error <0.5%, perf within tier, no quality regressions on 3 smoke prompts.

otto: will add bench YAML snippet to PR. no objections otherwise.

maya: i'll draft PR w/ snippets and UX copy for opt-in longpin.
